array_factor defaults are d_lambda 0.5 and n 8.
results/tables/precoding_comparison.md says Toy 4x4 PASS. experiment_summary.md says MIMO e2e PASS.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: # gunnchOS MIMO & Smart Antenna Lab > This repo is part of the **gunnchOS wireless engineering spine**: hands-on labs that strengthen the technical foundation behind 7GC, AI-RAN, RF, DSP, MIMO, measurement, and **6G PhD readiness** for target wireless communications engineering programs. Not affiliated with any university.
